question: Should Crabline preserve upgrade compatibility for existing artifact-directory ownership and the stable readiness `recorderPath`, or intentionally ship both as breaking persistence-contract changes?
rationale: The patch can fail existing installations and changes a consumed artifact schema; tests cannot determine whether those breakages are acceptable product policy.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Keep the stable `recorderPath`, add a versioned snapshot field, and provide a safe ownership migration or compatibility path for existing directories.

options.title: Ship a breaking contract
options.body: Accept strict ownership and the new path semantics only with explicit versioning, operator migration instructions, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Land interruption, tail-repair, and lock fixes separately while deferring ownership and artifact-schema changes to a dedicated design change.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the stable `recorderPath`, add a versioned snapshot field, and provide a safe ownership migration or compatibility path for existing directories.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged channel-driver work introduced the OpenClaw bridge surface whose artifact contract is being changed.
